env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOARCH=amd64
env GOAMD64=
env GOARM64=

logos build -o $WORK/base-amd64 .
exec go version -m $WORK/base-amd64
stdout 'GOAMD64=v1'

env GOAMD64=v3
logos build -o $WORK/base-amd64-env .
exec go version -m $WORK/base-amd64-env
stdout 'GOAMD64=v1'
! stdout 'GOAMD64=v3'
env GOAMD64=

env GOARCH=arm64
env GOARM64=v8.3
logos build -o $WORK/base-arm64-env .
exec go version -m $WORK/base-arm64-env
stdout 'GOARM64=v8\.0'
! stdout 'GOARM64=v8\.3'
env GOARM64=
env GOARCH=

-- go.mod --
module example.com/baselinelvl

go 1.27

-- logos.toml --
[build]
target_cpu = "baseline"

-- main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("hello")
}
